description: Returns whether media is ready to play, for an import and for a direct upload alike: progress and error, then its duration (milliseconds) and resolution (null when not measured). `ready` is true only once the file has been analysed; call again while it is false and `error` is null. status `failed` with an `error` is final: the file is not usable; remove it with upload_remove.
name: upload_get_import_job_state
title: Get media state
